sources.title: LoRA Adapters Explained - openinnovation.ai
sources.snippet: LoRA adapters offer a lightweight way to fine-tune large language models without retraining billions of parameters. Learn how they reduce costs, accelerate deployment, and enable modular AI systems.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.snippet: An important paradigm of natural language processing consists of large-scale pre-training on general domain data and adaptation to particular tasks or domains. As we pre-train larger models, full fine-tuning, which retrains all model parameters, becomes less feasible. Using GPT-3 175B as an example — deploying independent instances of fine-tuned models, each with 175B parameters, is […]
